scope: Unchanged native finite algebra, rational geometry, word witnesses, and exact counterexamples. Angle lifts, Schlaefli variation and phase descent have written proofs/contracts in THEOREM.md; no blanket continuum or quantum-gravity certification.

rules.source: P projects onto the hinge plane
R^2=-(I-P) on the oriented Euclidean normal plane

negative_controls.name: lift:identity_holonomy_does_not_force_zero_deficit
negative_controls.written_proof: THEOREM.md H3: sums are exactly 2*pi and 4*pi; deficits are 0 and -2*pi. Positive principal simplex angles fix the lifts.

negative_controls.name: bulk:curved_example_is_not_vacuum
negative_controls.reason: The exact vacuum equation and 0<theta<pi require theta=2*pi/3, hence x=4.

negative_controls.name: action:area_variation_is_not_unconstrained_angle_variation
negative_controls.reason: Four hinge areas are functions of the same interior edge, not four independent variables.

negative_controls.name: phase:half_weight_does_not_descend_to_unlifted_SO2
negative_controls.interpretation: For q=1/2, a 2*pi change in lifted angle multiplies exp(iota*q*delta) by -1.

lift.source_of_lift: positive simplex angles and oriented incidence, with written branch proof

interior_edge.source_scope: Chosen Regge-plus-information action, no cosmological term, fixed boundary lengths, twice differentiable information functional.

quantum_phase.conditional_descent: exp(iota*q*delta) is a function of SO(2) holonomy alone iff q is an integer, for every real lift delta
quantum_phase.alternative: Retain delta, or use a specified cover; then integer area weights do not follow.
quantum_phase.scope: Single-hinge phase factor. No path-integral measure, physical boundary amplitude or Lorentzian quantization is certified.
